title: PMDD & partners — couple CBT (Nadia, 36)
caption:
Couples therapy for PMDD worked as well as going alone (PLOS ONE, 2017).
A diagnosis takes daily tracking across 2 cycles. Track it together.
Send this to him. Does he know your day 24?
www.aiforheratx.org
#pmdd #pmddawareness #womenshealth #cycletracking #premenstrual #relationships

scenes.text: Everyone told her it was just PMS. At 1am she found the actual name: PMDD.
phrases: It's just PMS. Everyone gets it.
I googled it at 1am. It has a name, and it's PMDD.

scenes.text: Her therapist offered couples sessions. He braced for being blamed, and came anyway.
phrases: He sat down in session two.
She braced for 'so she's the problem'.
In the trial, couples did as well as women going alone (PLOS ONE, 2017).

scenes.text: Tonight he adds her day 1 to his own calendar (IAPMD). Saturday they walk together.
phrases: Tonight: he puts her day 1 in his own calendar (IAPMD).
They both track the same 2 cycles, then take the record to her clinician.
Saturday: a 30-minute walk together, part of 150 minutes a week (WHO).
